note: errors.As to *temporal.ApplicationError together with NonRetryable() is a decision (true: a non-retryable application error). The call outcome table lists it as a kind of failure.

paths.text: Start -> Charge (activity) --failure--> if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.NonRetryable() --true--> End
Start -> Charge (activity) --failure--> if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.NonRetryable() --false--> End (completed)
